title: Task breakdown
description: Output of the architect role: an approved spec split into ordered, PR-sized tasks.

summary.description: The approach in a few sentences.

tasks.description: Tasks in the order they should be done. Task n is referred to by its position n, from 1.

description.description: Markdown: what to change, where, and how to test it.

needs.description: Worker labels the task needs (toolchains, OS, services), lowercase, e.g. go, node, linux.

size.description: s: under ~100 changed lines, m: under ~300, l: under ~600.

depends_on.description: Positions of earlier tasks that must be merged first.
